prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the bustling energy of a shipyard dock. On the far left stands a tall crane with a rusted hook, its metal structure faintly tinted with gray wash. Next to the crane, a man in a blue cap leans against a wooden crate, his posture relaxed. A brown dog sits on the ground beside him, looking up attentively. In the center foreground, a woman in a yellow raincoat points toward the water, her arm extended clearly. She stands next to a large coil of thick rope that rests on the damp planks. Behind her, a boy in striped shorts looks at the pointing woman, his expression curious. To the right of the boy, an old sailor with a white beard holds a clipboard, checking off items. Near the sailor, a black cat perches on a barrel, watching the scene with narrowed eyes. Further back, a seagull flies above the water, wings spread wide. On the dock edge, a fisherman in green waders casts a line into the dark water. Beside him, a small wooden boat bobs gently, tied by a frayed string. A child in a red hat runs past the fisherman, chasing a rolling apple. Near the center right, two workers in orange vests carry a heavy steel beam together. One worker wears a hard hat, while the other has bare head. They walk past a pile of scattered nails. In the background, a cargo ship looms large, its hull painted with faded red stripes. A ladder hangs from the ship's side, leading down to the dock. At the base of the ladder, a mechanic in greasy overalls tightens a bolt on a pipe. A wrench lies on the ground next to his boot. Above them, a flag flutters from a pole, showing faint colors. Near the flag, a lantern hangs unlit from a beam. A pigeon roosts on the lantern's top, preening its feathers. In the distance, a tugboat emits a thin trail of smoke. There is no sun visible in the sky. There is no modern concrete pavement. There is no digital signage or electronic screens.
